metadata.title: Mandovi River 3D Bathymetry & Hydrographic Depth Dataset
metadata.description: Continuous, scientifically verified bathymetric digital twin model of the Mandovi River based on CSIR-NIO Geophysical & Geomorphological survey.
metadata.authority: Goa State Biodiversity Board (GSBB) / Directorate of Mines and Geology, Government of Goa
metadata.survey_institution: CSIR - National Institute of Oceanography (CSIR-NIO), Dona Paula, Goa
metadata.official_report: Geo-morphological studies and EIA/EMP for the sand mining clusters of Rivers in Goa - Mandovi River Pre & Post Monsoon Report (August 2021)
metadata.vertical_datum: Chart Datum (CD) / Mean Sea Level (MSL) [Mormugao Port Hydrographic Baseline]
metadata.acoustic_sounder: Bathy-500HD Precision Echo Sounder (33 kHz / 50 kHz / 210 kHz dual frequency)
metadata.sub_bottom_profiler: Applied Acoustics Squid 500 Sparker System with 8-element hydrophone streamer
metadata.side_scan_sonar: EdgeTech 4125 dual frequency (400 kHz / 900 kHz) with 200m swath range
metadata.sediment_sampler: Van Veen Hand Grab Sampler (34 stations, uppermost 5 cm)
survey_provenance_types: OBSERVED_SURVEY: Direct single-beam echosounder & grab measurements from CSIR-NIO survey
INTERPOLATED_CROSS_SECTION: Bank-constrained parabolic cross-section interpolation strictly inside river polygon
MODELLED_1D_HYDRAULIC: Backwater hydraulic profile from Manning-Strickler 1D solver

reaches.name: Miramar - Aguada Bay Estuary
reaches.description: Estuarine mouth with wide deep navigation fairway between Aguada headland and Miramar bank.

reaches.name: Panaji Promenade & Atal Setu Triple Bridges
reaches.description: Deep scoured navigation channel beneath Atal Setu and Mandovi bridges; bedrock at 12m-20.5m depth.

reaches.name: Ribandar - Chorao Island Navigation Channel
reaches.description: Fluvial navigation channel flanking Salim Ali Bird Sanctuary and Chorao mangrove wetlands.

reaches.name: Narve Village Reach (Figure 14)
reaches.description: High energy reach with rock outcrop and sand mining zone; acoustic basement bedrock at 8.5m-17m.

reaches.name: Piligao Reach (Figure 15)
reaches.description: Lenticular facies and mining cluster; seismic bedrock observed at ~21m.

reaches.name: Amona Bridge Reach (Figure 16)
reaches.description: Two prominent scour depressions where riverbed drops to 16.5m below CD; bridge pier base and shadow zones.

reaches.name: Vedanta Pig Iron Plant, Navelim (Figure 17)
reaches.description: Industrial reach with barge loading jetties; bed depth 7.8m-14.5m, bedrock 9.5m-20.5m.

reaches.name: Volvoi - Cotombi Reach (Figures 18 & 19)
reaches.description: Deep submerged valley feature reaching 16.6m depth; high lateral gradient between bank bars and central canyon.

reaches.name: Khandepar - Vagurme Reach (Figure 20)
reaches.description: Upper tidal confluence with three deep scour depressions down to 14.5m; coarse sand and cobbles.
